crossRefs.note: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but…
David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except…
He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback…
So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was…
Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
translations.bsb: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready, mounted the camels, and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
translations.kjv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
translations.asv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
